replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Looks small so far, and it reminds me of Rendezvous 2 a lot, plus it has void near monuments which would make it even more chaotic, it's also too blocky and simple, the gameplay wouldn't be the best.

I'd suggest making it bigger and adding more shape to it, relocate the monuments, make it less flat (by adding stairs, slabs, multiple levels like underground, etc!)
Try to make your map unique. A map that doesn't look like anything that is already in rotations :) I hope this helps!
Good luck with your map!
